messages:
mira: Early-morning perf CI flagged +18% p95 on small-batch tail for ronin bench. run id: run-2026-03-18-09. snapshot and logs: https://ci.internal/bench/run-2026-03-18-09
kai: Saw it. Any diffs/PRs that landed overnight? batching or scheduler flags?
mira: Yep — PR #4827 changed batcher backoff timing: https://git.internal/r/4827. I reran locally with old flags and it matches baseline.
chuck: Can you paste the metrics? p50/p95/p99?
mira: p50 +2%, p95 +18%, p99 +30%. Host CPU jitter also higher.
ops-bot: Alert created: PERF-2026-03-18-09 — paging oncall.
linh: I'm oncall, grabbing traces. Mira can you dump the sample set? `curl -o samples.json https://ci.internal/api/runs/run-2026-03-18-09/samples`
mira: Done — uploaded to s3://bench-samples/run-2026-03-18-09.json
linh: Running flamegraph (ETA ~10m). Ping if you can produce a low-noise repro.
kai: I'll try a bisect across 4812..4828. If it's backoff we'll see batch queue growth.
mira: Also noticed quantization config tweak in model-serve/deploy.yaml in the same window — flagging.
chuck: Also check infra change #190 for cpuset/affinity — cc @infra-team
mira: Links: flamegraph https://kibana/fg/run-2026-03-18-09 ; bench details https://ci.internal/bench/runs/run-2026-03-18-09
linh: Flamegraph shows more time in `batcher::drain` and `kernel:spin_wait` — attaching screenshot :camera_flash:
kai: Looks like spinwait contention. Try repro with: `./bench --batch-size 8 --no-spinbackoff`
mira: Started repro run run-2026-03-18-09a with --no-spinbackoff. If it returns to baseline we can revert the flag or patch backoff.
ops-bot: Incident updated: PERF-2026-03-18-09 status=investigating assignee=linh
linh: Quick update: repro run returned baseline with --no-spinbackoff. Bisect in progress to find exact commit. Will propose rollback patch if bisect narrows it.
mira: Thanks — handing to oncall for follow-up/rollback. Leaving thread open for postmortem notes.
